action: The following changes are proposed to the Instructions for the Treasury International Capital (TIC) Form B Reports. (1) Raise the reporting thresholds for the TIC BC, BL-1, BL-2, BQ-1, BQ-2 reports from $50 million for the Grand Total row and $25 million for any individual line item to $250 million for the Grand Total row and $100 million for any individual line item ("Exemption Levels," section I.C.4). (2) Expand allowable signatures to include an individual performing equivalent functions to a duly authorized officer ("Signature Requirements," section I.F.3). (3) Clarify that reporters include Central Clearing Counterparties ("Who Must Report," section I.C). (4) Clarify that the definition of Foreign Official Institutions for the purposes of TIC reporting excludes enterprises that are owned by a government but that do not serve a governmental function such as national defense ("Foreign Official Institutions," sections II.B.1a, III.B.1a, and IV.B.1a) (5) Clarify wording about how to fill in columns of TIC Form BQ-3 ("Non-Negotiable Deposits & Brokerage Balances (Column 1)," section VIII.C.1.a, and "Loan Claims Excluding Resale Agreements (Column 3)," section VIII.C.1.c).
